subject.title: feat: AI safety event taxonomy — UI dashboard and CLI command

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a dedicated core AI-safety taxonomy and observability subsystem, or express these records through the existing diagnostics stability contract?
rationale: The choice fixes the permanent schema, public SDK and RPC surface, security provenance, privacy allowlist, persistence owner, and UI/CLI product model; automation cannot safely choose those contracts.

options.title: Extend diagnostics stability
options.body: Use the existing sanitized diagnostics recorder, read-scoped RPC, persistence path, and CLI as the canonical backend, adding a safety-focused UI projection only after the schema is approved.

options.title: Approve a dedicated subsystem
options.body: Keep the separate safety API only with an explicit owner decision plus SQLite retention, bounded redaction, descriptor registration, canonical severities, upgrade tests, and real UI/CLI proof.

options.title: Pause the four-PR series
options.body: Close or defer the stack until a narrower design issue establishes taxonomy ownership, privacy rules, and the minimum operator-facing surface.

recommendation.title: Extend diagnostics stability
recommendation.body: Use the existing sanitized diagnostics recorder, read-scoped RPC, persistence path, and CLI as the canonical backend, adding a safety-focused UI projection only after the schema is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work directly owns trusted diagnostic dispatch and the OTEL security boundary this decision would extend.
